points.statement: An experience-augmented planning framework enables embodied agents to build and use mental models via natural interaction with their environment.
points.quote: We introduce MINDSTORES, an experience-augmented planning framework that enables embodied agents to build and leverage mental models through natural interaction with their environment.

points.statement: The approach extends zero-shot planning by keeping a database of past experiences that informs later planning iterations.
points.quote: Drawing inspiration from how humans construct and refine cognitive mental models, our approach extends existing zero-shot LLM planning by maintaining a database of past experiences that informs future planning iterations.

points.statement: Accumulated experiences are represented as natural language embeddings of tuples, which a planner retrieves and reasons over to guide refinement for new states and tasks.
points.quote: The key innovation is representing accumulated experiences as natural language embeddings of (state, task, plan, outcome) tuples, which can then be efficiently retrieved and reasoned over by an LLM planner to generate insights and guide plan refinement for novel states and tasks.

points.statement: The architecture capitalizes on structured reasoning while grounding outputs in physical-world dynamics.
points.quote: This “brain and body” architecture capitalizes on the LLM’s capacity for structured reasoning while grounding its outputs in the dynamics of the physical world—a critical capability for real-world applications like robotic manipulation (Shentu et al. 2024; Bhat et al. 2024; Wang et al. 2024b), autonomous navigation (Zawalski et al. 2024), and adaptive disaster response.

points.statement: Relevant information is stored back into the database for later reference.
points.quote: Store relevant information back into database to refer to later.

points.statement: The system first plans an action but learns from past experience that the attempt will fail.
points.quote: The system initially plans to mine iron with a wooden pickaxe but learns from past experience that this will fail.

points.statement: It then updates the plan to include an intermediate step first, leading to successful mining.
points.quote: It then updates the plan to include creating a stone pickaxe first, leading to successful iron ore mining.
